text: Luxury Wellness Resort in Doha, Qatar | Zulal Search Search Serenity Adult Retreat EXPLORE MORE Discovery Family Retreat EXPLORE MORE Discover Zulal Wellness Resort by Chiva-Som, Qatar Where the stillness of the desert meets the gentle embrace of the sea at Qatar’s northernmost tip, Zulal offers a sanctuary of renewal. Rooted in the wisdom of traditional Arabic and Islamic medicine, this serene haven blends heritage and holistic well-being in perfect harmony. As one of the most distinctive GCC wellness resorts in Qatar, this luxury resort offers two distinct experiences in the Middle East: Zulal Serenity, crafted for adults seeking tranquillity and lifestyle transformation, and Zulal Discovery, inviting families to connect and create lasting memories through shared wellness journeys. Traditional Arabic & Islamic Medicine (TAIM) Zulal Wellness Resort in Qatar is the first wellness destination to bring the profound wisdom of Traditional Arabic and Islamic Medicine (TAIM) into the modern age. Inspired by Ibn Sina’s Canon of Medicine from 1025, TAIM recognises individual “humour” types as the foundation of personal health and balance. Guided by these timeless principles, our experts in Qatar apply evidence-based practices to promote holistic well-being. Among Middle East resorts, Zulal brings cultural heritage and modern wellness together in a distinctive approach to healing and holistic well-being. She also highlighted her stay at one of the leading luxury resorts in the Middle East.
